close_reason: Already tracked v0.1 limitation: self-issued cert pathLen exemption explicitly marked #[ignore] in PKITS tests with 'tracked for v0.2' comment. Not a regression.
description: RFC 5280 §6.1.3(d)(3) says self-issued intermediate certs MUST NOT be counted against pathLenConstraint. The current pathLenConstraint check at line 846 uses (i-1) as the raw number of certs below position i, without exempting self-issued certs. PKITS §4.6.15 and §4.6.17 test this and are currently marked #[ignore]. This means chains with self-issued cross-certificates will be incorrectly rejected with PathTooLong even when RFC 5280 permits them.
title: pathLenConstraint ignores self-issued cert exemption
